entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' for product help or 'Sales' for new orders.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand sensor you sent me is a piece of garbage. I want my money back.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. To best help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's a technical fault! The pulse reading is wildly inaccurate. It's either 30 beats too high or it doesn't read at all. I **don't have time** to play games with this thing. I **just want money** back for this junk. I need a **refund**.

I certainly understand your frustration. Sometimes the sensor's accuracy can be improved with a quick software update or a reset. Would you be open to trying a few quick troubleshooting steps with me?

Absolutely not! I'm not your unpaid quality tester. I paid for a working product, not this piece of **garbage**. Are you going to process my refund or do I need to speak to your manager and write a review about this disaster everywhere I can?

Okay, I understand completely. No problem at all. Let me just pull up your order information and review the return eligibility for you. Can I have your order number or the email address you used to purchase?
It's under angrycustomer@email.com. Just get it done.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered 19 days ago. Let me just check our policy...
Alright, I've confirmed it. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery for a full refund.

Since you are well within that 90-day window, I have gone ahead and approved your return. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to your email. Once our warehouse receives the band, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Fine. That's all I wanted in the first place. Make sure that label is in my inbox.
It has been sent. You should see it within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
